stages.purpose: Turn an underspecified theme into user-selected, catalog-grounded build directions before a job or quota-bearing build identity is created.
Select or normalize an exact catalog-constrained build plan from approved candidates.
Resolve approved immutable AWS assets and verify their manifests, hashes, interfaces, and required nodes.

Exhaust legal local bus and carrier contacts, inject the minimum additional compatible ESP32-and-carrier nodes, keep Grove on XIAO expansion-base nodes, and emit a bounded secret-free ESP-NOW star contract when more than one controller is required.
Require each selected immutable asset to pass its declared rigid connector-family pitch, row-spacing, contact-count, and exact sale-form geometry contracts before wiring intent is requested.
Choose bounded presentation metadata for immutable, prevalidated wire endpoints.

Construct connector-normal, tangent-fillet wire geometry and continuously reject segment-solid intersections, loops, self-intersections, duplicate carrier endpoints, same-net crossing waivers, keepouts, invalid endpoints, excess cable length, and measured bend radii below the conductor contract.

Fetch and hash-verify approved CloudFront GLBs, apply accepted immutable node transforms, and render the compiler's bend-safe route samples by arc length without a client-side spline that can overshoot them.
